title: South Kensington Local Medical and Support Points
summary: Designated 24-hour A&E hospitals, secondary trauma centres, and local supply points in and around South Kensington.
content:
1. NEAREST 24-HOUR ACCIDENT & EMERGENCY (A&E) HOSPITALS:
- Chelsea and Westminster Hospital: 369 Fulham Road, London, SW10 9NH (approx. 1.2 miles southwest - verify locally). Provides 24/7 emergency medical care and urgent treatment.
- St Mary's Hospital: Praed Street, Paddington, London, W2 1NY (approx. 1.8 miles north - verify locally). Major trauma centre with 24/7 full A&E services.

2. ALTERNATIVE MAJOR HOSPITALS (A&E):
- Charing Cross Hospital: Fulham Palace Road, Hammersmith, London, W6 8RF (approx. 2.5 miles west - verify locally). 24/7 A&E and acute medical services.
- St Thomas' Hospital: Westminster Bridge Road, London, SE1 7EH (approx. 3.2 miles east - verify locally). Full 24/7 emergency department opposite Parliament.

3. LOCAL PHARMACIES & MINOR AILMENTS:
- High-street community pharmacies (e.g. Boots, local independent chemists on Old Brompton Road / Brompton Road - verify locally) provide over-the-counter medication, first-aid items, and minor illness advice when open.

4. ESSENTIAL SUPPLIES AND INFORMATION HUBS:
- Large local supermarkets (e.g. Sainsbury's on Cromwell Road, Waitrose on Gloucester Road - verify locally) serve as primary points for non-perishable food, bottled water supplies, and public community noticeboards during widespread outages.

5. IMPORTANT NOTICE: In major disasters or power outages, hospital operating procedures, transport links, and commercial opening hours may be disrupted. Verify status locally before travelling.
